name: ITPI Excess Factor
description: Publisher-side (Antipodean) ITPI rating table, loaded by P22 from verticals/antipodean/reference/. Held as records rather than inlined in the engine flow so a rate change is an edit, not a deploy. 29 discrete excess points from $100 to $20,000. They are POINTS, not a curve: $250 — the minimum excess on 329 of the 344 quotable ITPI occupations — is not among them, so the engine needs a stated rule for a value between two points before it can rate a default quote.

factor.description: Multiplier applied to the premium. 0.999 at $100 down to 0.5 at $20,000.
